reviewed_state: First four commits replayed; KVarN feature staged and uncommitted. Static review only.
conclusion: No actionable source rebase regression found in the reviewed scope. All 738 distinct scheduler/cache/GDN CPU test cases pass after two test-fixture field repairs and environment-specific reruns. Device correctness and performance remain unqualified until the operator GPU handoff.

checks.area: Lookahead hashes and DFlash prefix reuse
evidence: KVCacheCoordinator.__init__ forwards num_hash_lookahead_tokens to every physical BlockPool (kv_cache_coordinator.py:120).
Scheduler keeps use_eagle distinct from use_eagle_block_drop and clears only the block-drop behavior when lookahead hashes are enabled (scheduler.py:297-359).
Coordinator retains separate eagle_group_ids and drop_eagle_group_ids; unitary and hybrid cache lookups use the latter (kv_cache_coordinator.py:141-150, 630, 769).

All three get_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_position calls in _mamba_block_aligned_split retain upstream num_hash_lookahead_tokens; MambaManager predictor and checkpoint cache publication retain their upstream lookahead arguments.

OffloadingConnector.bind_kv_cache_manager now derives its replay boundary callback from drop_eagle_group_ids (offloading_connector.py:64), matching the no-drop DFlash policy. Offload lifecycle is separately reviewed.
checks.result: Upstream hash-proof and no-drop semantics preserved.

checks.area: Allocation, full-sequence admission and async-load reservation
evidence: KVCacheCoordinator.get_num_blocks_to_allocate_by_pool preserves each manager's upstream predictor arguments, including apply_admission_cap and prefill_end, and accumulates by the group's physical pool (kv_cache_coordinator.py:260).

KVCacheManager.allocate_slots applies full-sequence admission, watermarks and reserved capacity against each physical pool, with strict tuple-length validation for reservations (kv_cache_manager.py:523-615).

Scheduler computes speculative decode reserves and in-flight prefill reserves per pool; the existing Mamba cap is limited to RUNNING requests in a single-group independent pool (scheduler.py:379, 3469).

MambaManager.cap_future_reservation remains the old fork behavior: it declines the optimization for fine-grained hashing and pending COW, credits only private ref_cnt==1 blocks, and leaves actual per-step allocation on the upstream predictor (single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:1815).
checks.result: No new cross-pool capacity borrowing or speculative admission regression found.

checks.area: Speculative acceptance, deferred frees and COW
evidence: KVCacheManager.allocate_slots retains the upstream processed-token boundary before freeing skipped blocks and caps cache publication to committed request.num_tokens (kv_cache_manager.py:578-650).
Scheduler request-free/COW fencing and _drain_deferred_frees retain the upstream implementation; releases use MultiBlockPool.free_blocks when independent pools are present (scheduler.py:3151-3184).
MultiBlockPool groups by physical pool while preserving within-pool order, and BlockPool.free_blocks retains upstream null-block skipping and actual-owner delegation (block_pool.py:823, 969).
take_pending_kv_cache_block_copies retains both endpoints with group_id attached to each copy; attention and recurrent zeroing IDs are also group-qualified (kv_cache_manager.py:867-925).
checks.result: Scheduler-side lifetime and namespace obligations are preserved; worker execution of copies and offload fences is covered by the separate lifecycle review.

checks.area: Qwen GDN identity and native guards
evidence: QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention.mamba_type returns QWEN_GDN_ATTN only for XPU, otherwise delegating to the upstream GDN identity (qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py:547). This avoids breaking new Qwen4 experimental NVIDIA/AMD state-copy maps keyed by GDN_ATTN.
QwenGDNAttentionBackend alone supplies the 64-token arithmetic-grid requirement; the default AttentionBackend hook returns None.

The scheduler arithmetic grid remains restricted to XPU, mamba_cache_mode=none, non-speculative, non-multimodal, non-encoder-decoder execution; cache-aligned checkpoints continue using upstream logic (scheduler.py:440-508).
_gdn_attention_core_xpu_impl retains exact request-index slicing, all speculative rollback columns, and the guarded mixed non-spec dispatch predicate (vllm/_xpu_ops.py:235-289).
Qwen forward_xpu retains the new upstream explicit Triton/SYCL backend choice.
checks.result: Local behavior remains narrowly scoped and new upstream GDN dispatch is preserved.

evidence: KVCacheConfig synthesizes the legacy shared pool when no explicit topology is supplied, validates explicit group ownership, and preserves upstream host-tier fields.
New pool_id and KVCacheBlockCopy.group_id fields retain defaults for legacy single-pool consumers.
KVarN quantization enum values occupy the separate 100-105 range and is_kvarn is additive.
The CUSTOM/OCTAVE_K3V4 enum alias is present in frozen upstream, not introduced by this replay; no unrelated repair is proposed.
Coordinator reset behavior is unchanged from both old fork and new upstream; the added facade's reset helper is not used by KVCacheManager.reset_prefix_cache.
checks.result: No new interface regression identified in reviewed scheduler-facing paths.
